# R5.1 — Retained supplemental coverage and routing guard

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/169_R5.1__guard.md` · sequence 169/246 · GATE-G8 bounded bootstrap (verbatim: "passed. please proceed", Devin Desktop chat, 2026-10-30T04:16Z) · offline-only, bash spend

## Summary

Implements `hh-supplement-guard/1`, the versioned, READ-ONLY supplemental
coverage/routing guard the evidence-and-adoption spec §9.4 requires before any
product dispatch, plus the negative-fixture battery proving it rejects every
recorded defect class. It reads existing records, emits input digests, counts
and actionable diagnostics, and writes no build state — it is never a second
state owner. The stock external validator and the repo row-tool checks are
unchanged; the guard consumes the stock checker's `build-memory-check/2`
sidecar for the scoped baseline comparison.

## What changed

- `docs/build/tools/supplement_guard.py` — the guard engine (python3 stdlib only; no new dependencies).
- `docs/build/tools/check-supplement-guard.sh` — entry point (repo-root anchored; `--json`, `--checker-json`, `--no-checker`, `--version`).
- `docs/build/tools/README.md` — the guard contract: checks, route verdicts, read-only properties.
- `docs/build/fixtures/supplement-guard/` — `run-fixtures.sh` + 13 mutation cases + stand-in `checker-green.json`.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0382-r5.1-supplement-guard-evidence-model.md` — the owned decision: landed-evidence model, diagnostic-class signatures, signature-freshness pool (index regenerated).
- `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — DF-R5.1-1 (OPEN): GATE-G17 contributor evidence owed for the ten owned targets.
- `docs/tickets/169_R5.1__guard.md` — GATE-G8 verbatim recorded in the Gate status block.
- `docs/build/runs/R5.1.md`, this file, `docs/build/README.md` Round-5 pointer line.

## Design decisions (ADR-0382)

- Completion evidence per kind: work kinds land via BUILD_INDEX rows; gates via
  PASSED GATE DECISIONS (a recorded non-PASSED decision is `failed-gate`);
  human rows via a recorded decision or non-pending readout.
- `nextTicket` must equal the active round's first unlanded row; skeleton first
  unlanded ⇒ `REFUSED` + error; pending/failed prerequisites stop dispatch;
  a pre-round `nextTicket` is `old-gate-routing` (legacy GATE-G1 never
  dispatches; its readout must match the baseline sha256 byte-for-byte).
- Historical diagnostics match the reviewed baseline's exact check/path/row
  classes one-for-one — normalized class signatures, never a warning count;
  unknown emissions and missing classes are both fatal.
- Active-round gate verbatims must not replay any pre-round signature pool —
  `signature-reuse`.
